reviews.text: Review for initial release: Game progresses in the same fashion of something like "Skul: The hero slayer" in the sense of it has a set "path" through a set order of stages, but with a random floor, items. But there seems to be a set boss for each stage. You make progress by collecting souls and buying upgrades that persist through each run. Weapons are diverse enough to not make everything feel all same-y. Especially with each weapon having their own combo system. I love that theres a lot of items that feel fitting in the Holo community including weapons and artifacts from other myth members. The song selection is fine for what it is. I havent completed the final areas yet so im still holding out for some of my favorite Mori tracks to show up. But I do like that you can swap out each floor's theme for other unlocked tracks. My only complaints: > Mori has a voiceline for literally EVERY action. Every dodge and attack makes her say something. Which is silly at first but can get annoying fairly quickly (especially with a weapon that attacks very fast, like the fists.) which can cause her to just rapid fire voice lines (Like in fist of the north star) > When singing on the stage of the shop, theres only a text box of a music note. Nothing else happens. This would be a cool opportunity to have some other Mori songs randomly play out, but nothing happens. > Some enemies can still shoot you while youre melee'ing them which turns into a net negative trade when theres hundreds of them and only one of you. Especially when theres limited ammo youre more likely to run only melee and save your ammo for the boss of the stage. > It would also be really cool to improve the melee weapons a small amount. Like some of them have REALLY bad like full second of start/end lag, leaving you completely open for attacks. Maybe allow the player to dodge roll at the end of their attacks to get around this? Or just make the start/end lag not so painful. > The starting room has a sort of trophy room / collection to show you stuff you previously found. But for some reason its just kinda off to the side. You cant walk up and interact / view them. Would be cool to let us at least interact with them in some way. > All pickups (HP, ammo, ect.) are marked as a blue dot on the map which can cause situations where you need to revisit every room with a blue dot just to find the one dropped food piece you were looking for. Stuff that id want: > Maybe add a NPC that upgrades/enhances your current weapon. Like add new perks to it instead of having perks be tied to random weapon drops. > Add the ability to destroy unwanted items/weapons for souls/gold. Would be cool instead of just leaving them there on the ground. > Let us fight both available bosses per floor. (You can only enter one of the boss rooms on each stage. And the other will lock) > Let us spend some of our spare souls/gold at the start of the game to buy a weapon of choice instead of taking only the random weapon at the start. (This would give more value to the perks that let you retain a portion of your souls/gold from the last run.) > Maybe let the player buy more song options from the starting shop using spare souls or something (Basically I just want more Mori songs to choose from lol) > More boss variety for each stage. Currently theres one standard boss per stage. With a rare "???" alt boss. Would be cool to have more boss variety for each stage. > A stats page on the main menu would be cool. Just nerd stats like how many runs youve completed, enemies killed, ect. Slight spoiler complaints: > [spoiler] Alt characters are tied to random weapons. I kinda just wish you could play whichever character you wanted after you unlock them.(Speaking of, wheres playable Ame and Gura?) [/spoiler] > [spoiler] Alt characters are somewhat bugged in the sense of their character gets swapped back to default Mori when youre talking to some NPCs. They also only have Mori's character sprite on the map instead of an Ina or Wawa head. [/spoiler] > [spoiler] Im not sure how it works, but I guess you arent allowed to get the real final boss on your first successful run. Because death sensei just kinda says "Yeah the God youre looking for isnt here. Better go look for him!" And then the run just ends abruptly. That was very unsatisfying [/spoiler] The game is definitely a solid time especially for something only $7 I give it a like 8/10

If you're a Mori fan (especially of the music like me) this might be an easy buy for you despite some of the issues with the game. I was extremely interested because of the similarities with games like enter the gungeon which I loved as well. Negatives: Melee feels both super powerful and really crappy at the same time and can vary wildly from weapon to weapon. Melee is very committal and has significant startup and recovery times (for most weapons). There is a dodge roll but unfortunately you can't animation cancel melee attacks into it and there is a fairly lengthy amount of time you have to wait until the dodge roll activates after you melee. I think this is what makes the melee combat feel crappy for me, being locked into animations and recovery way too long. Some ranged enemies do a pretty ridiculous amount of damage and once they start shooting there is no interrupting them with melee attacks (unless you cc with a freeze or something on the melee weapon), they will keep shooting while you're hitting them. This is probably my biggest complaint which is exacerbated by not being able to roll to cancel a melee attack. Often you might dive in on a group with melee but if one or a few happened to start shooting before you hit them, OR if you simply missed them because they weren't in your aoe, you're basically dead since you can't dodge roll out to save yourself from them shooting. Imo melee should interrupt all shooting for normal enemies. Positives: Didn't really have anything to complain about with the guns, they felt fine. There seem to be a decent amount of items and weapons in the game to play around with, it feels like there are some secrets and interesting modifiers to levels that will occasionally trigger when starting a run that makes things significantly harder but also gives lots more rewards too. You will probably get your moneys worth from the content in the game. I was only able to clear up to stage 3 (before the boss) playing somewhat casually so I can't say specifically how much content you're really getting, but it looks to be a pretty decent amount. While the music might get repetitive for some people there is a jukebox you unlock in the shop which lets you change around the music for each stage. I'd also recommend just having a random option so it cycles through the music you unlocked rather than manually selecting which tracks you want for each stage every time you want to change it or get tired of it. Recommendation: Unfortunately I refunded because the melee was too annoying to deal with, and depending on your rng with guns, plus rng with ammo drops, you may have to resort to using melee more often and take unnecessary amounts of damage unless you slow down your gameplay significantly to try and pick enemies off 1 by 1 in some cases, run around a corner, try to bait enemies to shoot and go in after (if there are multiple ranged it becomes even more tedious). I didn't wanna do that as it felt like it completely ruins the faster pace of the game. So right now I don't think I'd recommend it but try it out for yourselves and see if you like it. I think most people will likely be perfectly happy paying the 7-10 dollars despite its small issues. Wish it had a demo since I don't like refunding things but yeah. I'll be keeping an eye on the development again and buy it once it looks like melee combat is a lot more fluid and satisfying to play with.

[h1]重生之我是死神大弟子[/h1] 我其实没看到宣发内容，单纯是打开ytb刚好看到死神自己在玩。标题画面的bgm是出道曲RIP，进入游戏后的bgm是deadbeats。俯视角rogue，武器分近战远程，每件近战武器有不同的combo数，就是打完一套完整的连招需要几次平A，大差不差都是突刺蓄力转圈抡几下，单纯论打击感而言还不错，但平A本身不能把怪打出硬直，因为不能取消近战后摇反而会硬直自己，哪怕数值再高也要优先考虑带冰冻麻痹词条的武器，实战体验很尴尬。同时近战还不能砍掉子弹更没有近战击中回复弹药这种设定，使得远近输出方式更加割裂，我运气比较好捡到了传说激光枪，随便打打就通关了（当然只是普通结局）。收集灵魂可以解锁各种道具加成，这就属于roguelite的基础内容了，没什么好说的。 Holo Indie发行的游戏大小也玩了很多个了，可能是因为开发者们本身就都是管人痴，这使得他们产出的作品都很擅长抓住粉丝向游戏的主要矛盾，努力让操作holo角色这件事变得很有趣。一个月会员的钱就能操作死神砍几个小时，后续还会解锁myth其他几名角色（不清楚有没有阿梅），实在没有什么差评的理由。没中文，rogue本身捡到啥用啥不影响玩但有些对话内容事关隐藏要素，所以游戏虽然能硬啃，但硬啃又有点不太可能。 粉丝向游戏不打分。 LuGN: 44.5/50

DO NOT BUY. HOLOLIVE/MORI FANS PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE BUYING. Honestly, even though I played it and it felt "okay" for $7, the developer is LITERALLY JUST DOING A LAZY, MINIMAL EFFORT RESKIN to his old game from 4 years ago, I can't with all good conscience recommend this to ANYONE. Even if you love Calli or Hololive, don't support this lazy greedy dev trying to capitalize on the Hololive name and it's fans. Go see his original game that he reskinned, "Raspberry Mash", and you'll see that the gameplay, weapons, UI, and even enemies are the same. The only changes I noticed are the characters skin changed to Mori (and can unlock Ina), the shop keepers and scientist skin to "death", added the Hololive symbol/arrow to the gold coins, changed the name to some items to be Hololive/Calli references (but effects are the same), and adding Calli's music that plays while you play. Again, all of this is just RESKINNING. MAYBE he added some new bosses, but almost all, if not every, enemy is the SAME AS HIS ORIGINAL GAME. Again, the dev is just trying to capitalize on the Hololive name and it's fans in a LAZY AND GREEDY WAY. I would say that about 85-100% of this game is just reskinned content, with 0-15% actually being added/new content. DO NOT BUY, DO NOT SUPPORT. PLEASE.

It is similar, but it doesn't play out as smoothly. There are two buttons for a ranged and a melee attack, as opposed to EtG's one button. There is this annoying buffer where you have to pull out your other weapon and wait for the animation to finish before attacking. The movement feels slightly sluggish at times, such as your character slowing down when reloading. I'm not sure how much Mori has contributed to the creation of this game, but it feels slightly off? In a sense that some of her voicelines seem to be extracted from her livestreams or something. TLDR: I think overall it still is a good game, if the dev mixes controls/movement like WOWOWOW Korone Box!! Into this game, it would be perfect! As of writing, I've beaten the 5 main floors of the game and I would say overall it's pretty good. I'm happy to support the dev/devs behind this :)

As others have said, this is just a re-skin of the dev's other game, Raspberry Mash. Enemies, floors, weapons, and bosses are all the same. The artifacts are all redone to be Hololive themed, and there are some fun references. The type that require more than just a quick Google search. So the dev is clearly a fan, the game is just a cheap re-skin. Does that make the game bad? No. Does it make it feel cheap? Yes, but the game itself is also cheap. In fact, cheaper than the game it's a re-skin of. If you don't want to support a re-skin, by all means I understand. If you don't care that it's a re-skin and want a game starring our lord and savior, Mori Calliope, then you'll have fun. MYRIAD DEATH is a roguelike not unlike something like Enter the Gungeon. Melee will be your main focus, but you also have a gun. Almost all the weapons are exactly the same as Raspberry Mash, but with some new Hololive Myth themed weapons (Ricky, Gura's trident, Kiara's sword, etc.). There are 6 floors total. The goal is to clear all 6 floors on one life. There are some secret/alternate floors as well (these are required to reach the final boss). Just like any other roguelike, the floors are all randomized, alongside your weapons and upgrades. It's a mix of skill and luck. I found blue lasers to be the best ranged weapons. Clears out bosses in no time. There are a couple of new Hololive themed secret bosses, and some new Mori specific environments. So it's not 99% just Raspberry Mash. More like 98% or 97%. All BGM is pre-UMJ Mori songs. They are also cut down and loop a lot. Voice lines are also just taken from Mori clips. If the developer reads this, feel free to contact Mori. During her stream of this game, she said she's willing to provide voice lines and Universal Music permission if you just ask her. Especially since this is holo Indie published, it would definitely help make the game feel a bit more quality. Some suggestions to the dev that could hopefully be added in an update: - Option to disable alternate skins. It's cool to be able to play as other Myth members, but sometimes I just wanna stick with Calli. - Speaking of, is there really no Amelia Watson skin? Could she be added in an update? There's an artifact based on her, Non-Fiction is in the game, but Ame isn't in it? It's weird that eveyone else in Myth is nicely represented, but Ame is missing. - Please add a shuffle option for the jukebox. I would love to just have a random song play on each floor, and have it change when the song ends. You can only listen to Dead Beats and Huge W looping so many times. - More songs? Maybe some of the Universal Music songs? Like Calli said, if you just contact her, she'd be able to grant permission.

一周目真神结局通关，简单评测一下 最大的亮点是近战，这个暴力帅气又优雅的近战动作真的爽，每把武器的连段攻击都不一样，有些是真的又帅又强，但是近战武器后摇很大，面对远程围攻或者boss时很容易挨打，所以我一直采取的策略都是先用远程武器清远程怪，打boss几乎全程远程（除了个别几个boss有比较长的僵直时间），然后能用近战就都用近战，远程的子弹有限，需要节省 要通关的话也不难，前期灵魂把一些基础性的东西升一升，前期要是运气好拿到好武器还能顺便通个关，中后期直接用灵魂解锁新武器，解锁后会现场给你一把，解锁的都是罕见和传说武器，一周目远程武器首选步枪，然后是弹夹直伤足够的持续激光，能不能凑元素反应看运气了，一周目直伤够了，后面更高难度我还没打，猜测可能后面可能会更依赖元素反应 游戏是有真通关和伪通关的，怎样解锁真通关可以去网上找《炸裂树莓浆》的攻略，至于为什么是炸裂树莓浆，因为这游戏就是炸裂树莓浆的换皮游戏，开发商都是同一个

It's hard for me to truly recommend this game to anyone that randomly happens upon this game. I did enjoy the time I had with it but that was [i]before[/i] I learned that it was a reskin of the dev's previous game. [b](I'll admit I impulse bought this game because Calli, thus missing the game description as a result.)[/b] Because of this, a lot of the Holo-related stuff does feel a bit shoehorned in and the enemies don't quite fit into the Holo theme either. Plus the grind to get the last two achievements (44,444/444,444 destroyed objects) can and most likely will be a pain for those who look to complete the game in that sense. (Can we [b]AT LEAST[/b] be able to track our progress for something like that? Please?) Would I like to see the game better themed to Hololive? For sure. Would I like to see a greater collection of music and better loops for some current songs? (Looking at you Dead Beats.) Would likely be a hard thing to do considering the potential licensing for some of the newer stuff, but if it can be worked out then I'd be all for it. Whether the dev will or won't make such changes to the game? Hard to say at this point, but I personally hope they consider it at the very least, give the game a fresh coat of paint. Given the above mentioned things and the "game is a reskin" line of thinking, it'd understandably be hard to pick this game up. If you're able to look past all that then I do recommend it (albeit with a huge caveat).

I like a lot of the ideas in this game, but I feel like the execution of them is poor. Ranged weapons have limited ammo, so you're encouraged to use melee attacks. But a lot of the monsters have ranged attacks. There's a dodge roll, but it doesn't move you further than just walking does, it's just i-frames. But dodging also doesn't animation cancel, making it hard to time those i-frames meaningfully. But lets assume that you manage your ammo and just use the ranged weapons against the ranged opponents, shooting ranged weapons also reduces your movement speed making it hard to dodge attacks. (there's an item you can get to remove that slow-down, but very RNG to get it) Ranged weapons also need to reload frequently... and that's also an animation that you can't cancel with the dodge roll. None of this is insurmountable, it's not an impossible game by any stretch of the imagination, but it makes it feel bad to play, and makes a lot of deaths feel cheap because whoops I accidentally clicked one too many times to attack and now I'm locked into a long combo animation and can't avoid taking that hit. Melee weapons have distances that they'll move you on attack, depending on the weapon + items and which attack you're on in the combo, but then you have the problem of either weapons leaving you (nearly) stationary and vulnerable to the many monsters that are ranged or have dash attacks, or they move you too far and leave you out of position and surrounded all the time or running into attacks. Again, not insurmountable, but just another thing making me feel like I'm fighting against the game, rather than against the monsters. I like the music in this game, but as a very minor nitpick I think the vocals for the level BGM are a bit much/distracting? You can change it, but only after you've beaten the levels...

Don't get me wrong, this is a good game with decent gameplay, but the biggest issue/deal breaker I have with this game is of how lazy and unoriginal this game feels. The entirety of the game is a copy paste reskin of the developer's previous work Raspberry Mash right down to the gameplay, concept, enemies/bosses, weapons, and scenery. The only differences include the plot, artifacts, and a few minor details but its less of an impact than you think. Seriously, compare the trailers and you can see that barely anything notable was changed. At least the music is good, but considering all of the music is hololive music (not even remixed mind you), its not saying much. The only saving grace is that its notably cheaper than the original and has more content in the form of a hard mode which sounds like a bit like an insult if you think about it. It just makes me feel like this is a poor attempt to ride the hype train that was holo indie's growth. In short, anything you can say about Raspberry Mash can be said about this game but if you had to choose between the two, save yourself the trouble and pick this one every time.

(Hololive / Fangame / Twin Stick Shooter / 2025) Top-Down Action-Roguelike where you fight hordes of enemies and bosses using weapons with different abilities. CONTAINS: Mori Calliope.
This action roguelite shines through tight, twin-stick shooting and a robust dodge-roll mechanic. Varied weapon drops from scythes to spell-casts offer branching playstyles, and boss variety excels.
Combining elements of bullet hell and action RPGs, MYRIAD DEATH offers a unique gaming experience. Players control Mori Calliope as she battles through waves of enemies, collecting powerful weapons.
[8/10] MD delivers fast-paced roguelike action with standout weapon variety: over 200 melee and ranged tools drop in chaotic, pixel-art dungeons. Combat is fluid and responsive, feeling great!
Beyond its punishing exterior, MYRIAD DEATH possesses a surprising depth in its build customization. The arsenal of weapons and abilities allows for significant experimentation, besides satisfaction.
MYRIAD DEATH is a bit punishing yet fair, with satisfying feedback on every hit and a rewarding progression curve.
Hardcore players will relish the challenge, while the tight mechanics keep the action engaging from first run to last. The indie charm shines through in its tight gameplay and relentless pace.
If you crave tough, deliberate action, this title delivers. It’s not about flashy gimmicks but about mastering movement, resources, and encounter design across increasingly brutal floors.
